# Generated PRDs\n\nThis directory contains Product Requirements Documents generated by the SPARC PRD Agent.\n\nPRDs are automatically saved here with filenames like:\n- `prd-project-name-YYYY-MM-DD.md`\n\nEach PRD includes:\n- Executive summary\n- All SPARC phases (Specification, Pseudocode, Architecture, Refinement, Completion)\n- Research sources and citations\n- Generation metadata
